name: RivalOut – AI-Driven Competitive Intelligence Platform
author: rivalout

sections.description:
RivalOut Competitive Intelligence helps startups and small-to-medium businesses save time and gain strategic insights by automating competitor research. With this plugin, you can instantly access RivalOut’s powerful competitive intelligence tools right from your WordPress dashboard, giving you real-time competitor tracking, traffic metrics, keyword ranks, and actionable insights—starting at just $29 per month.

Key features include:
– Real-time competitor updates
– Traffic Monitoring Metrics
– Business Profile Information & Ratings Monitor
– Keyword Search Results Rank Tracker
– Social Media Channels Monitor
– Sector Average Metrics
– AI-driven SWOT analysis and insights

All insights are delivered through RivalOut’s seamless, AI-driven platform, making it easy to stay ahead in your industry.

– RivalOut Homepage
– RivalOut Blog
– Pricing Plans
– Contact Support
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a RivalOut subscription?

Yes, this plugin requires an active RivalOut subscription. Visit RivalOut Pricing for more details.

Is the data in real-time?

Yes, RivalOut provides real-time updates and insights to ensure you stay ahead in your competitive landscape.

How secure is the connection to RivalOut’s platform?

RivalOut uses secure HTTPS connections for all data transfers, ensuring your information remains safe and private.
